title: Custom Outdoor Kitchen With Twin Eagles Grill & Pizza Oven
description: Our team supplied the equipment for this beautiful outdoor kitchen build featuring Twin Eagles 54” Gas Grill, Twin Eagles 24” Power Burner, & multiple Twin Eagles storage components. The best was also used for refrigeration with True Residential 15” Ice Maker, 24” Refrigerator, & 24” Beverage Center. For pizza night, one of the best gas pizza oven’s currently on the market, Alfa Forni Brio. 4 Infratech Dual Element Electric Heaters were installed to keep the entire space warm for year-round enjoyment. Exceptional build & finish work by @jonbijaricustomhomes @zicanasurfaces
summary: Equipment for a builder-led outdoor kitchen in Roslyn Harbor, designed with Jon Bijari and Zicana Surfaces.
solution: Twin Eagles 54-inch gas grill, 24-inch power burner and storage components; True Residential ice maker, refrigerator and beverage center; an Alfa Forni Brio gas pizza oven; and four Infratech dual-element electric heaters for year-round use.
ourRole: We supplied the equipment. The build and finish work were carried out by the builder and stone fabricator.
takeaway: Supply-only works well when the equipment is chosen before the island is built, because the appliances set the cut-outs.
